passages.notes: UTF-8 body SHA256 including final LF 1ca5613b8bca7d4132094a70554093c41b456ae85520f133860a77a7c46dc355. Target conclusion: Per Dominum nostrum. Historical conclusion: Per Dominum nostrum etc. Pustet capitalizes Paschale, omits the target comma after ut, and actually prints Per Dominum nostrum etc. Target prints Per Dominum nostrum. The printed etc. is neither expanded nor attributed to the target; no words follow the actual target stop. Both page images print foedere, with oe ligature expanded mechanically; fcedere is recognizer damage.

work.description: A project-created editorial source projection containing bounded Latin prayer bodies in date-specific artifacts. It is neither an edition of a historical hand missal nor an edition of the Missale Romanum. Each artifact records the transformation rule over separate public-domain antecedent and 1962 page-image witnesses; its passages let consumers cite the projected bodies without assigning Triptych's target-controlled collation choices to the antecedent printing.
